say:5:1120604003:1.text: A famous treasure hunter once said: "True treasure hunters must be able to feed their families with just their sense of smell."
say:5:1120604003:1.source_cn: 有位宝藏猎人说过：“真正的宝藏猎人，必须能凭借自己的嗅...
say:5:1120604003:1.male: A famous treasure hunter once said: "True treasure hunters must be able to feed their families with just their sense of smell."
say:5:1120604003:1.female: A famous treasure hunter once said: "True treasure hunters must be able to feed their families with just their sense of smell."

say:6:1120604004:1.text: In that respect, I suppose you could call us "treasure hunters".
say:6:1120604004:1.source_cn: 按照这个标准，我们只能“勉强”算是宝藏猎人。
say:6:1120604004:1.male: In that respect, I suppose you could call us "treasure hunters".
say:6:1120604004:1.female: In that respect, I suppose you could call us "treasure hunters".

say:7:1120604005:1.text: I'm ashamed to admit it, but this is our first time looking for treasure this far away from home.
say:7:1120604005:1.source_cn: 说来惭愧，其实这还是我们第一次离家这么远来寻宝。
say:7:1120604005:1.male: I'm ashamed to admit it, but this is our first time looking for treasure this far away from home.
say:7:1120604005:1.female: I'm ashamed to admit it, but this is our first time looking for treasure this far away from home.

say:8:1120604006:0.text: We only came here because we heard there was treasure in the area, but then we ran into those bandits...
say:8:1120604006:0.source_cn: 我们是听说这里有宝藏才赶来的，可没想到会被匪徒盯上……

say:12:1120604007:0.text: So you're not from around here, huh? No wonder your accent sounds so much different from everyone else's.
say:12:1120604007:0.source_cn: 原来你们不是本地人，怪不得口音听起来和这里的人一点都不像。

choice_prompt:13:1120604007.text: So you're not from around here, huh? No wonder your accent sounds so much different from everyone else's.
choice_prompt:13:1120604007.source_cn: 原来你们不是本地人，怪不得口音听起来和这里的人一点都不像。

say:14:1120604008:1.text: That was most likely my fault...

say:15:1120604009:1.text: The treasure those bandits were asking about... We made it all up back at a tavern in Alkali.
say:15:1120604009:1.source_cn: 刚才那两个匪徒打听的“英灵宝藏”，其实是我在咸水镇酒馆...

say:16:1120604010:1.text: You know how it goes, right? A warm fire, lots of drinks, a minstrel singing songs all night... It's easy to get carried away in that kind of place!
say:16:1120604010:1.source_cn: 你知道的，酒精、炉火，吟游诗人的小曲，在那种环境下，谁...

say:17:1120604011:1.text: I tried to convince the tavern keeper to waive our tab by making up a bunch of treasure-hunting stories. I even spun a tale about a legendary treasure and threw in some name that an old Mauler once told me: Lester.
say:17:1120604011:1.source_cn: 为了让酒馆老板免单，我编了很多寻宝时的“英勇事迹”，为...

say:18:1120604012:1.text: You've already seen the kind of trouble we're likely to find. Sorry we got you wrapped up in it.
say:18:1120604012:1.source_cn: 结果你们都看到了。让你们卷入其中，实在抱歉。

choice_prompt:19:1120604012.text: You've already seen the kind of trouble we're likely to find. Sorry we got you wrapped up in it.
choice_prompt:19:1120604012.source_cn: 结果你们都看到了。让你们卷入其中，实在抱歉。

say:21:1120604014:1.text: Come on, Evan! We still need to get our stuff back from those bandits!
say:21:1120604014:1.source_cn: 艾文，别发呆了，我们得把匪徒抢走的行李捡回来。

say:24:1120604016:1.text: To keep hunting for treasure, of course! We can't give up halfway through our first adventure away from home!
say:24:1120604016:1.source_cn: 当然是继续寻宝了！这是我们第一次离家来寻宝，怎么能半途而废。
say:24:1120604016:1.male: To keep hunting for treasure, of course! We can't give up halfway through our first adventure away from home!
say:24:1120604016:1.female: To keep hunting for treasure, of course! We can't give up halfway through our first adventure away from home!

say:25:1120604017:1.text: Sure, but we need to get our stuff back from those bandits first.
say:25:1120604017:1.source_cn: 好吧，不过我们得先把匪徒抢走的东西捡回来。
say:25:1120604017:1.male: Sure, but we need to get our stuff back from those bandits first.
say:25:1120604017:1.female: Sure, but we need to get our stuff back from those bandits first.

say:26:1120604018:1.text: Let's give them a hand, Magister!
say:26:1120604018:1.male: Let's give them a hand, Magister!
say:26:1120604018:1.female: Let's give them a hand, Magister!

choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 匪徒为什么会盯上你们？

choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 现在该说说宝藏的消息了吧！
